description: Recommended intakes (RDA/AI), upper limits (UL, with scope e.g. "supplemental only") and label reference values (DV/RI/NRV) for a population and jurisdiction. Each value carries its source and a cite line.

jurisdiction.description: Whose reference values: US (NIH ODS RDA/AI/UL, Dietary Guidelines CDRR, FDA Daily Values) or EU (Regulation 1169/2011 RI/NRV, which UK labels also use). No other jurisdiction is held yet: CA, UK, AU and the rest are refused with this list, never answered with an empty list.
